value_reasons: 새 기능 표현(할 수 있게 됨) +5
top.detail: Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2, our new models for the hardest technical challenges. Fable 5.2 sets a new bar in coding, finance, and the sciences. / Introducing Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2 \ Anthropic Skip to main content November 9, 2026 Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 We’ve upgraded Claude Fable and Claude Mythos—models that are designed to tackle the most daunting technical challenges. Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2 show improvements in areas like coding, reasoning, and vision. During prerelease testing they’ve helped our engineers complete otherwise-infeasible software migrations, designed three working electronic devices from scratch, solved two open problems in the physics of black holes, made substantial progress on robotics evaluations, and formalized the proof of Fermat’s Last Theorem in 30 hours—among many other applications we’ll discuss below. Claude Fable and Claude Mythos are the same underlying model. Fable has strong cybersecurity and biology safeguards to guard against misuse, which allows us to make it available to all users. Organizations pursuing beneficial applications in cybersecurity or biomedical research can apply for access to Mythos through our recently expanded Life Sciences and Cyber Verification Programs. Testers have found that Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 communicate more clearly than past Fable and Mythos models. They generate outputs up to 30% faster than Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1, and they’re available a…

top.detail: Today Anthropic, PBC launched the roadshow for its proposed initial public offering of its Class A common stock. / Anthropic launches roadshow for proposed initial public offering \ Anthropic Skip to main content Related articles Anthropic files S-1 with the SEC for proposed initial public offering View more Today Anthropic, PBC launched the roadshow for its proposed initial public offering of its Class A common stock. The proposed offering consists of 825,000,000 shares of Class A common stock. Of these, 801,351,354 shares are being offered by Anthropic and 23,648,646 shares are being offered by certain existing stockholders. Anthropic will not receive any proceeds from the sale of shares by the selling stockholders. Anthropic also expects to grant the underwriters a 30-day option to purchase up to an additional 123,750,000 shares of its Class A common stock. The initial public offering price is expected to be between $70.00 and $78.00 per share. Anthropic has applied to list its Class A common stock on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the symbol “ANT.” The proposed offering will be made only by means of a prospectus.
